title: LLDP: update power-over-MDI decoding to 802.3-2022
description:
- decode PD 4PID in Power type/source/priority
  - this was formerly a reserved bit
- decode PD Load in System setup
- format new 802.3bt power values as Watts
- add more information for 802.3bt properties
